meta.name: gpt-image-edit
meta.description: Edit images with OpenAI GPT Image 2 (the `/edit` endpoint of ChatGPT Images 2.0) on RunComfy — bundled with the model's documented prompting patterns so the skill gets sharper output than naive prompting against the same model. Documents GPT Image Edit's strengths (preservation language, multilingual in-image text editing, multi-reference up to 10 images, layout / typography precision), the schema, and when to route to Nano Banana Edit / Flux Kontext / GPT Image 2 t2i instead. Calls `runcomfy run openai/gpt-image-2/edit` through the local RunComfy CLI. Triggers on "gpt image edit", "gpt-image-edit", "chatgpt image edit", "edit with gpt image 2", or any explicit ask to edit with this model.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用GPT Image 2编辑图片，支持多图参考与文字修改
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用AI精准编辑图片中的文字或布局。
copy.tagline_en: Edit images with GPT Image 2, supporting multi-reference and text editing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI-powered image editing with precise text and layout control.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你编辑图片，比如替换背景、修改图片中的文字、把多张图片合成一张，同时保持人物面部、品牌标志等关键内容不变。
howto.when: 当你提到“gpt image edit”、“chatgpt image edit”或明确要求用 GPT Image 2 编辑图片时，Claude 会调用这个技能。

say.text: 把这张海报的标题改成日文“コーヒー”，其他不变。
把人物1放到房间2里，保持人物面部不变。
say.note: Claude 会合成两张图片，保留人物身份。

say.text: 把背景换成暖灰色摄影棚，保持人物和品牌标志不变。
say.note: Claude 会替换背景，保留主体。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can edit images for you, such as replacing backgrounds, modifying text within images, or composing multiple images into one, while preserving key elements like faces and brand logos.
howto.when_en: The skill triggers when you mention "gpt image edit", "chatgpt image edit", or explicitly ask to edit an image with GPT Image 2.

say_en.text: Change the headline on this poster to Japanese "コーヒー", keep everything else.
say_en.note: Claude will call GPT Image Edit to replace the text.

say_en.text: Put subject from image 1 into room from image 2, keep the face unchanged.
say_en.note: Claude will compose two images while preserving identity.
